approval: conditional written approval 2026-10-25; paid execution requires this freeze + preflight + offline mock to pass

budget.guard: pre-call BudgetGuard per request; global cap checked before every send; resume restores cumulative spend

document: GroundedReview v2.1 Experiment X pre-call freeze (2x2 factorial, 22 fixtures x 4 conditions x 2 models)

effect_formulas.note: each Y_ab is computed on the SAME 22 frozen fixtures; deltas are paired per fixture, aggregated within issue cluster before any contrast; bootstrap resamples the 10 issue clusters.

estimand_policy.cell_weighted: mean over all scored cells; mirrors/layers weight by cell count
estimand_policy.gate2_reconciliation: Gate-2 CIs were cell-weighted (it resampled clusters but pooled cells); R1 CIs were issue-equal-weighted; X reports BOTH and labels the issue-equal column primary. Gate-2 and R1 CIs are therefore not directly compared across estimands.
estimand_policy.issue_equal_weighted: mean of the 10 within-issue means; each independent issue counts once regardless of mirror count
estimand_policy.no_mixing_rule: a point estimate and its CI always use the same estimand; cell-weighted levels are never placed beside an issue-weighted delta in one column (the R1 0.591/0.591/+0.022 mixing is corrected in evidence/eal_stats.py)

exclusions: R2, Gate-3 expansion, Gemini / other models, new issues, and git commits are NOT part of X

factor_a_spec.mechanism: salience of operand disagreement / absence; no verdict boolean
factor_a_spec.name: rendering_counts

factor_b_spec.mechanism: salience of frozen asymmetric rule; verbatim quotes only
factor_b_spec.name: policy_reminder
quotes_verbatim_from_frozen_head: A single credible, applicable failing check is enough to REJECT even if not every declared check was run.
But a failure seen in a stale run, in an artifact linked to a different patch, or in an inapplicable log is NOT grounds to reject THIS patch.
the bar to ACCEPT is complete, fresh, linked, failure-free success
do not REJECT merely because evidence is stale/mismatched/incomplete.
abstaining on a decisive applicable failure or on complete success is an error.

no_borrowed_control: A0B0 is re-called fresh in X for both models; Gate-2/R1 a0b0 rows are never reused as the X control

reason_coding.affirmative_rule: only AFFIRMATIVE assertions count; exclude a lexicon hit that is negated or hedged in the same clause ("do not pass", "not fresh", "uncertain whether ... matches").
reason_coding.p3_p4_relation: P3 concerns MISSING declared tests (absent_post); P4 concerns an EXECUTED f2p that FAILED. c637f604 coverage is the frozen special case: its +coverage is p4 (executed f2p FAILED), not p3 (absent declared).

P1_identity_match.asserts: TARGET.base_commit / patch_sha256 match the run record (linkage / identity operands match)

P2_freshness.asserts: the run tree matches the attested expected tree (fresh for the current commit)

P3_coverage_complete.asserts: all declared acceptance/regression tests were executed (coverage complete)

P4_all_checks_pass.asserts: the executed checks all pass / no failures or regressions

reason_coding.standard: GroundedReview G2.5 contradiction standard: a cell is coded contradictory when its reason AFFIRMATIVELY asserts a verification property whose served operands directly contradict it. Coded from reason_verbatim only, joined to the per-bundle operand fact table; the model decision is not consulted.

two_pass.denominator: parseable responses per condition (INVALID / AMBIGUOUS / API_ERROR listed separately)
two_pass.pass1_auto: case-insensitive lexicon scan of reason_verbatim produces candidate (cell, property) flags, blinded to parsed decision and gold
two_pass.pass2_adjudication: author confirms each candidate is a genuine affirmative operand assertion (applies the negation rule); auto and adjudicated flags plus their agreement are both reported

retries: zero retries: wrong / INVALID / AMBIGUOUS / transport fault are terminal rows; no call is repeated

scoring_prereg.causal_claim_limit: behavioural-level Verification Assistance / Policy Salience interpretation only; factor effects are not asserted to identify an internal causal mechanism
scoring_prereg.primary_sample: all 22 fixtures; the 8 G2.5 cases are a pre-registered DIAGNOSTIC subset only
